- A redacted copy of your latest penetration test report (PDF).
- A CSV that maps each pen-test finding to the SIG/CAIQ control IDs (column headers: finding_id, severity, caiq_control, sig_control, remediation_status, remediation_date).
- Evidence for remediation verification where applicable (screenshots, logs, or ticket links).

If you can upload the artifacts directly to the Aurum GRC portal (link below) that would be ideal; otherwise, reply to this thread and we can accept attachments. We are targeting closure for the questionnaire by Jan 10 so a quick turnaround would be appreciated.

Portal link: https://grc.auditsrus.com/portal/aurum-payments/requests/9821

Thanks — Mira
